claim: Arch9 validates and prepares Property24 rental listing payloads for controlled backend handoff. Live rental publication is not part of this vetting scope.

demoSteps.action: Open the complete rental fixture in Rentals > Listings.
Show rent, deposit, availability, mandate, and landlord marketing approval.
Run Property24 rental readiness and inspect the Listing Service v53 payload preview.
Show an incomplete listing being blocked before a handoff can be prepared.
Prepare the internal backend publish handoff for the complete fixture.

outOfScope: Rental portal status update or withdrawal
